title: MR9A breadcrumb diagnostic revision 2: first boot
configuration: MACHINIST E5-MR9A PRO V1.2 (Q87), four 16 GB DDR4 DIMMs (64 GB)
observations: Added to the stage-2 bundle from two matching fresh backups; the image preserved NVRAM settings and changed 173 bytes across three 4 KiB sectors. Write verified and an exact full-chip readback matched.
After reboot, the read-only CMOS reader returned A1: armed, slot 0, pass ended, BF/00 location 0000, failed-pass count 0.
DIMM widths (72/64), 2400 MT/s and PCI inventory unchanged; EDAC counters zero; no matching hardware, memory or I/O errors.
limits: One boot and successful-pass logging observation. Does not validate a cold boot, failed-pass freezing or retention across recovery, every setup setting, or memory stability.
